products.name: Google Vertex AI
products.note: Unified ML platform; Model Garden; AutoML; MLOps lifecycle; BigQuery integration; TPU support

profile_text.body:
Google Cloud is the cloud computing division of Google, operating under the public company Alphabet Inc. (ticker: GOOGL, CIK: 0001652044). The company describes itself as offering AI and cloud computing services covering security, data management, and hybrid and multi-cloud environments. Its site positions the platform around building AI agents and generative AI applications, citing access to over 200 foundation models and an ecosystem of AI partners.

The primary AI product tracked for Google Cloud is Google Vertex AI, a unified machine learning platform that encompasses Model Garden, AutoML, MLOps lifecycle tooling, BigQuery integration, and TPU support. The site also describes an Agent Platform, characterized as a fully managed AI development environment for building and managing AI applications and agents, with access to Agent Studio and the 200-plus foundation models. Google Cloud additionally promotes an ecosystem of Gemini products for businesses and developers, including a Gemini Enterprise app. The site cites Best Buy as a customer using Google Cloud generative AI to power virtual assistants in its customer care operations.

No litigation cases or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts for Google Cloud at this time.
